EU Court Upholds Record €4.1 Billion Fine Against Google

Europe's top court has rejected Google's final appeal against a record €4.1 billion antitrust fine. The fine was imposed by EU antitrust regulators for abusing the popularity of its Android operating system to block rivals. This ruling is expected to bolster the EU's efforts to regulate Big Tech companies.
